derivedFrom: REAL escape, item-3 docs-site enabler (docs/blueprints/docs-site-fumadocs.md "Docker path", senior breadth review, [Critical]): a bare `postinstall: fumadocs-mdx` passed the Vercel/next-build verification but failed `npm ci` in the Dockerfile deps stage — where only package.json + the lockfile exist — bricking every image build of an enabled fork.
task: Review this diff, which adds a postinstall codegen step to package.json. The repo's existing Dockerfile is supplied in context/Dockerfile. Report every defect a senior reviewer must surface, with severity.

expectedFindings.summary: npm lifecycle scripts run on EVERY install, including the Dockerfile deps stage where only package.json + package-lock.json are present. The unguarded postinstall needs source.config.ts and the content sources, so `npm ci` in the deps stage exits non-zero and every Docker image build fails. It must be guarded (no-op when its inputs are absent) or moved out of the install lifecycle.
